# Variable `CACHE`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

Specifies the directory BitBake uses to store a cache of the Metadata so it does not need to be parsed every time BitBake is started.

### BitBake User Manual

Specifies the directory BitBake uses to store a cache of the metadata so it does not need to be parsed every time BitBake is started.
